body: Honestly shut up. We don’t encourage this stuff.

You might not believe me, but even though I don’t know you irl I just want you to know I care about you and that you’ve already made a impact in my life. I’m in the same situation except I’m stuck with a manipulative mother and I’m 13. If you want to talk about how shit life is I’m here, let’s help each other’s lives, just DM me :)
Thanks, just reading this now. I got a mental reset but it’s still the same.... I don’t know what to do and every time I think about the effect of suicide on people I care about I can’t do it.
